name: CalendarRangePicker
description: a picker for selecting a date range on a calendar
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: `role="application"` -- indicates that the widget manages its own keyboard interactions, overriding standard screen reader navigation
`aria-label={label}` -- provides an accessible name for the calendar range picker
keyboard: No keyboard interactions — this is a passive element
props: `label`: string (required) -- accessible name describing the picker purpose, applied via `aria-label`
`children`: slot (required) -- the calendar grid content including date cells and navigation controls
